---
title: "06.minimal_mul_ML_revised_compact"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
rm(list = ls())
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
set.seed(123)
```

# 1. Project paths and import data

```{r}
## ==========================================================
## Project paths
## ==========================================================
project_dir  <- "../../Result"
jiabo_dir    <- file.path(project_dir, "JiaBo")
exp_dir      <- file.path(jiabo_dir, "1exp")
deg_dir      <- file.path(jiabo_dir, "2DEG")
ml_dir       <- file.path(jiabo_dir, "3ML")
external_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "External")
figure_dir   <- file.path(jiabo_dir, "figure/ML2")
table_dir    <- file.path(jiabo_dir, "table")

source("../functions.R")
source("./single_marker_AUC_barplot.R")
source("./utilities.R")
source("./minimal_mul_ML.R")
load_required_packages()
create_project_dirs(figure_dir, table_dir)

positive_class <- "PAAD"
negative_class <- "Healthy"
discovery_item <- "tis"

## ==========================================================
## Input data
## ==========================================================
common_feat_exo <- read.csv(file.path(ml_dir, "common_feat.csv"))$gene

tis_deg <- read.csv(file.path(deg_dir, "03_Main_DEG_same_direction_in_TCGA_NAT.csv")) %>%
  Define_Change(., "adjP_main", "logFC_main")

common_feat_up <- dplyr::filter(tis_deg, change == "Up")$Gene %>% intersect(common_feat_exo)
common_feat_dw <- dplyr::filter(tis_deg, change == "Down")$Gene %>% intersect(common_feat_exo)

exo_raw <- load_discovery_rdata(file.path(exp_dir, "exo.RData"))
tis_raw <- load_discovery_rdata(file.path(exp_dir, "tis.RData"))

profile_exo  <- exo_raw$profile
metadata_exo <- exo_raw$metadata
profile_tis  <- tis_raw$profile
metadata_tis <- tis_raw$metadata
```

# 2. Prepare TIS and EXO discovery data

```{r}
# Use the 12 concordantly up-regulated genes from the common feature panel.
panel_genes <- common_feat_up

TIS_MergeData <- prepare_model_data(
  profile = profile_tis,
  metadata = metadata_tis,
  genes = panel_genes,
  negative = negative_class,
  positive = positive_class
)

EXO_MergeData <- prepare_model_data(
  profile = profile_exo,
  metadata = metadata_exo,
  genes = panel_genes,
  negative = negative_class,
  positive = positive_class
)

# TIS is used for minimal multigene classifier optimization and tissue-model validation.
TIS_split <- split_discovery_data(TIS_MergeData, p = 0.8, seed = 123)
TIS_train_all <- TIS_split$train
TIS_test_all  <- TIS_split$test

# EXO is used for compartment-specific plasma/exosome ERS evaluation.
EXO_split <- split_discovery_data(EXO_MergeData, p = 0.8, seed = 123)
EXO_train_all <- EXO_split$train
EXO_test_all  <- EXO_split$test

cat("TIS discovery data:", nrow(TIS_MergeData), "samples and", ncol(TIS_MergeData) - 1, "genes\n")
cat("EXO discovery data:", nrow(EXO_MergeData), "samples and", ncol(EXO_MergeData) - 1, "genes\n")
```

# 3. Minimal multigene classifier optimization based on TIS

```{r}
candidate_sets <- get_default_candidate_sets() %>% filter_candidate_sets(TIS_MergeData)

optimization_res <- run_minimal_optimization(
  candidate_sets = candidate_sets,
  trainData_all = TIS_train_all,
  testData_all = TIS_test_all,
  positive = positive_class,
  negative = negative_class,
  seed = 123
)

print(optimization_res)
save_csv(
  optimization_res,
  out_dir = table_dir,
  filename = paste0("multigene_classifier_optimization_", discovery_item, ".csv")
)

p_opt <- plot_optimization_results(
  optimization_res,
  title = paste0("Minimal multigene classifier optimization: ", toupper(discovery_item))
)
print(p_opt)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = file.path(figure_dir, paste0("multigene_classifier_optimization_", discovery_item, ".pdf")),
  plot = p_opt,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)
```

# 4. Final 3-gene ERS genes

```{r}
final_ers_genes <- c("LCN2", "LRRC42", "FLOT1")
final_ers_genes <- intersect(final_ers_genes, colnames(TIS_MergeData))
stopifnot(length(final_ers_genes) >= 2)

TIS_train <- TIS_train_all[, c("Group", final_ers_genes), drop = FALSE]
TIS_test  <- TIS_test_all[, c("Group", final_ers_genes), drop = FALSE]
EXO_train <- EXO_train_all[, c("Group", final_ers_genes), drop = FALSE]
EXO_test  <- EXO_test_all[, c("Group", final_ers_genes), drop = FALSE]
```

# 5. Tissue ERS model and external tissue validation

```{r}
TIS_fit <- fit_ers_models(
  trainData = TIS_train,
  genes = final_ers_genes,
  positive = positive_class,
  seed = 123,
  tune_svm = TRUE
)

TIS_model_list <- TIS_fit$models

external_paths <- build_external_paths(
  external_dir = external_dir,
  cohort_names = c("GSE28735", "GSE62452", "GSE71729")
)

external_cohorts <- load_external_cohorts(
  external_paths = external_paths,
  genes = final_ers_genes,
  negative = negative_class,
  positive = positive_class
)

TIS_validation_cohorts <- c(
  list(Training = TIS_train, Internal_test = TIS_test),
  external_cohorts
)

TIS_performance_obj <- make_performance_table(
  model_list = TIS_model_list,
  all_cohorts = TIS_validation_cohorts,
  trainData = TIS_train,
  genes = final_ers_genes,
  positive = positive_class,
  negative = negative_class,
  model_domain = "Tissue-trained ERS"
)
```

# 6. Plasma/exosome ERS model evaluation

```{r}
# The ERS genes are fixed, but classifier coefficients are trained within the EXO compartment.
EXO_fit <- fit_ers_models(
  trainData = EXO_train,
  genes = final_ers_genes,
  positive = positive_class,
  seed = 123,
  tune_svm = TRUE
)

EXO_model_list <- EXO_fit$models

EXO_validation_cohorts <- list(
  EXO_training = EXO_train,
  EXO_internal_test = EXO_test
)

EXO_performance_obj <- make_performance_table(
  model_list = EXO_model_list,
  all_cohorts = EXO_validation_cohorts,
  trainData = EXO_train,
  genes = final_ers_genes,
  positive = positive_class,
  negative = negative_class,
  model_domain = "Plasma/exosome-trained ERS"
)
```

# 7. Performance tables requested by reviewer

```{r}
performance_table <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  TIS_performance_obj$full,
  EXO_performance_obj$full
)

performance_table_for_manuscript <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  TIS_performance_obj$manuscript,
  EXO_performance_obj$manuscript
)

thresholds <- list(
  Tissue = TIS_performance_obj$thresholds,
  EXO = EXO_performance_obj$thresholds
)

print(thresholds)
print(performance_table_for_manuscript)

save_csv(
  performance_table,
  out_dir = table_dir,
  filename = "ERS_classifier_performance_full.csv"
)

save_csv(
  performance_table_for_manuscript,
  out_dir = table_dir,
  filename = "ERS_classifier_performance_table_for_manuscript.csv"
)
```

# 8. ROC plots for tissue and plasma/exosome compartments

```{r}
TIS_roc_plot_list <- save_roc_plots(
  roc_cohorts = TIS_validation_cohorts,
  model_list = TIS_model_list,
  genes = final_ers_genes,
  out_dir = figure_dir,
  prefix = "ROC_tissue_trained_ERS",
  positive = positive_class,
  negative = negative_class,
  plot_title_prefix = "tissue-trained ERS"
)

EXO_roc_plot_list <- save_roc_plots(
  roc_cohorts = EXO_validation_cohorts,
  model_list = EXO_model_list,
  genes = final_ers_genes,
  out_dir = figure_dir,
  prefix = "ROC_plasma_exosome_trained_ERS",
  positive = positive_class,
  negative = negative_class,
  plot_title_prefix = "plasma/exosome-trained ERS"
)

for (nm in names(TIS_roc_plot_list)) print(TIS_roc_plot_list[[nm]])
for (nm in names(EXO_roc_plot_list)) print(EXO_roc_plot_list[[nm]])
```
